description: A picture, so you can check your work. mode: "overview" (the whole building from the south-east, above; site context hidden), "plan" (the 2D plan drawing of a level, north up, with dimensions), "drawing" (an elevation or section, see get_drawing_svg), "element" (one element framed), "view" (a saved view), "current" (exactly what the user sees). Look after significant changes.

level.description: Level id or name for mode "plan"

offset.description: For a section drawing: where to cut, mm

view.description: Saved view id or name, for mode "view"

name: capture_view
title: Look at the model
